rationale: With only 25 minutes to close, RUN shows conflicting signals: price is above VWAP ($9.57) and the 9-EMA ($9.81), and the last candle showed a strong surge to $10.04 on elevated volume (198K vs ~70K prior bars), suggesting short-term momentum. However, the stock gapped up ~19% on a stale earnings beat (news from 1249 minutes ago), SPY is down nearly 4% with VIXY surging 23.6%, and the intraday range ($9.05–$10.63) reflects extreme volatility with ATR at $0.092 on 5m bars — making reliable stop placement difficult within the remaining time window. The risk/reward does not justify entry given end-of-day liquidation risk and the hostile macro environment.
